_comment: Tier-1 mcp_tool source presets for kafka-mcp (AU-KG.ingest.mcp-tool-connector). Mirrors the Kafka topic catalog into the KG as topic documents via the kafka-mcp MCP server. Contributed presets win over the central MCP_TOOL_PRESETS. Richer typed-node ingestion (topics/groups/brokers/partitions + links) is handled natively by kafka_mcp.kg_ingest via the kafka_ingest_catalog tool.
